mission_08: Well done! You have successfully scaled data to arbitrary ranges using sklearn's MinMaxScaler with the feature_range parameter. You learned how to scale sensor readings to [0, 100] and confidence scores to [-1, 1]. This technique is invaluable when you need to match the output range of your preprocessing to the expected input range of downstream systems. Common use cases include scaling to percentage ranges, neural network activation ranges, and visualization coordinate systems. The feature_range parameter makes this straightforward without manual formula implementation.
